subject.title: fix(cli): abort reaps autonomous executor process trees

question: Should abort guarantee termination of every turn-owned autonomous descendant, including processes that create a new session or process group, or only terminate the direct executor process group?
rationale: The reported incident involved credentialed autonomous work continuing after abort, while the proposed process-group boundary knowingly permits daemonized descendants to escape; repository history does not establish which security and compatibility contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Contain all turn-owned descendants
options.body: Require stronger OS-level containment or explicit descendant registration so abort terminates all autonomous work attributable to the turn.

options.title: Limit abort to process groups
options.body: Accept process-group-only termination, document the limitation, and make abort visibly report any known surviving work.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Keep the issue open while executor launching is redesigned so turn-owned work cannot daemonize outside the managed boundary.

recommendation.title: Contain all turn-owned descendants
recommendation.body: Require stronger OS-level containment or explicit descendant registration so abort terminates all autonomous work attributable to the turn.

likelyOwner.reason: The service-managed spawn policy and most surrounding lifecycle history route through this owner, making them the best available decision point for the abort contract.
